Unfortunately, I didn't realize the already huge beans would grow even larger and go over capacity. The first roast was pretty much ruined. First crack didn't hit until about ten minutes in (normal is five to seven minutes), and then it went straight to second crack within a minute or two. The result was an overroasted mess.

Second roast I accounted for the capacity issue by turning the heat up a notch. The roast cycle went as usual this time, but I think I just took them too far (FC - FC+, probably should have been City, maybe City+ by your recommendation).
